answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by monitoring aggregate behaviour, not just identities. It pairs submissions and measures correlation; a cluster that votes in lockstep, like jade and quartz drawn from one vault, has its voting weight geometrically decayed per matching round. To avoid decay an attacker must fund genuinely independent accounts, mimic diverse timing and choices, and accept slower, costlier coordination—making many cheap fake identities unprofitable.
